integrity: Proof uses explicit incidence-matrix rank and complete extension-type inventory. Verification code checks five representative finite designs and is not used to infer the unbounded statement. No independent scientific audit or priority certification.

title: Exactly two rank-four theories of nontrivial Steiner designs in point-collinearity language
